name: omp-honcho-memory
description: Unified Honcho cognition plugin for OMP, Claude Code, and Codex
author: Loveacup

scripts.build: bun build ./extensions/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.js --target bun --external @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent && bun build ./hooks/honcho-hook.ts --outfile ./dist/honcho-hook.mjs --target node && bun build ./hooks/honcho-mcp.ts --outfile ./dist/honcho-mcp.mjs --target node && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.verify: python3 verification/verify-raw-search.py && python3 verification/verify-raw-recall.py && python3 verification/verify-raw-injection.py
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run check && bun run build
